text:
Elena K.: Hey infra team — onboarding request for a new tenant (team 'Orion'). Need a new Azure subscription + VNet. Goal: run GPU training/serving (mixed workloads) and host model-serving clusters behind private endpoints. Can we scope networking + quota needs?

Simon R.: Welcome! A few quick Qs: which region (primary + DR)? GPU family required (A100 v3 / A10 / H100)? approx concurrent nodes and burst? Need stable egress IP(s) for customers to allowlist?

Elena K.: Primary = eastus, DR = westeurope. GPUs: primarily A100 v3 for training and T4/A10s for inference. Expected baseline: 8 A100 nodes, burst to 24 for jobs. Yes we need stable egress for third-party APIs (IP allowlist).

Tara G.: Also add product requirement: private access to Azure Container Registry + managed Redis — prefer Private Endpoints / PrivateLink equivalents. Tagging: team:orion, cost-center:orion-prod.

cloud-ops-bot: quota-request-template -> Please include: subscription ID, region, sku, resource type, current quota, requested quota, justification, target date. (see link: https://aka.ms/azure-quota-request)

Ben L.: For stable egress we should provision a Public IP Prefix (/28) + NAT Gateway attached to the GPU subnet(s). That gives a small pool of static IPs we control. Alternative is Azure Firewall with SNAT but cost is higher.

Elena K.: Good. Any preferences for subnet sizing? We plan to run node pools + control plane services. Recommend a separate GPU subnet for autoscaling pools.

Simon R.: Suggest layout: vnet /20, control-plane /24, gpu-pool /26 (supports ~60 nodes), infra-services /26, services-private-endpoints /28. We'll need route table for forced tunneling later if compliance requires outbound proxy.

Elena K.: Can you post the exact ARM/Terraform snippet we'll send to cloud ops + support?

Simon R.: Paste below. Use this to request NAT+prefix and quota.
```bash
# example az commands
az network public-ip prefix create -g RG-Orion-Network -n orion-egress-prefix --length 28 --location eastus
az network nat gateway create -g RG-Orion-Network -n orion-nat --public-ip-prefixes /subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/RG-Orion-Network/providers/Microsoft.Network/publicIPPrefixes/orion-egress-prefix --sku Standard --location eastus
az network vnet create -g RG-Orion-Network -n vnet-orion --address-prefixes 10.10.0.0/20 -l eastus
az network vnet subnet create -g RG-Orion-Network --vnet-name vnet-orion -n sn-gpu-pool --address-prefixes 10.10.64.0/26
az network vnet subnet update -g RG-Orion-Network --vnet-name vnet-orion -n sn-gpu-pool --nat-gateway orion-nat
```

Simon R.: For quota support template (paste into portal request):

"SubscriptionId: <sub>\nRegion: eastus\nResource: Standard_ND96asr_v4 (A100 v3 family)\nCurrent quota: 0\nRequested quota: 24 (concurrent GPUs)\nJustification: Team Orion training fleet to support production model retrains and batch experiments. Baseline 8, burst to 24 for scheduled jobs. Request date: 2026-04-01"

Elena K.: Also need limits for Public IPs and SNAT port exhaustion note — Azure docs say NAT gateway SNAT ports scale with number of Public IPs, so ask for prefix /28 to give 16 IPs. That will give healthy SNAT port headroom for thousands of concurrent connections per node.

Ben L.: Important callout: Managed GPU VM SKUs typically require subscription-level quota increases for vCPU and regional SKUs. For A100 v3 in eastus, ask quota for "Standard_ND96asr_v4" or the equivalent family. We should also pre-request Accelerated Networking SKU quotas if applicable.

Finance Bot: Reminder — add cost-center and expected monthly egress and GPU-hours to the ticket to trigger chargeback. Estimated steady-state: 8 A100 nodes (~$XXk/month), burst adds ephemeral costs.

Tara G.: On private endpoints: we need Private Endpoint for ACR and managed redis. That requires subnet with no NSG blocking Microsoft private link ranges and a DNS plan. Please ensure split DNS via Private DNS zones.

Simon R.: I'll open the support ticket with Azure and attach the ARM/Terraform and the quota template. I'll also create a request to cloud provisioning board for subscription + RBAC (owner for infra, contributor for team).

Elena K.: Quick Q on cost mitigation: can we suggest spot nodes for batch jobs and reserved instances for base capacity?

Ben L.: Yes — recommend base reserved commit for 8 GPUs (1y/3y) + spot for burst. Also enable node-level autoscaler and scale-to-zero for non-production workloads. We'll include that in the ticket notes.

Simon R.: Action items: 1) I will open the Azure quota/support case (assign to me) — ETA 30m. 2) Elena please confirm subscription ID and cost center. 3) Ben to draft Terraform module for VNet+NAT+prefix. 4) Tara to confirm private endpoint list.

Elena K.: Sub: sub-0a1b2c3d, cost-center: ORION-42. Confirmed. Thanks team.

Simon R.: Ticket opened: MS Support case 2300-xxxxx. Included: public IP prefix /28 request, NAT gateway setup, quota increase to 24 A100-family GPUs in eastus, increase Public IP quota to 32, vCPU quota increase for ND series. Linking here: https://portal.azure.com/#supportCase/2300-xxxxx

Elena K.: :thumbsup: I'll update onboarding checklist once NAT+quota are approved.

Ben L.: I'll start the Terraform skeleton in infra-modules/orion-vnet and PR to infra repo. Small note: make subnets have serviceEndpoints disabled and rely on PrivateEndpoints to avoid accidental public access.

cloud-ops-bot: auto-note: please add the support case number to the subscription's onboarding doc and mark as in-progress.

Tara G.: Thanks, all. If MS asks for expected sustained egress or peak connections, we estimate peak 15k outbound concurrent connections during dataset fetch windows.

Simon R.: Noted. Closing loop: will update this thread when quota is approved or if Azure requests more info.
